items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: The people who used to call the house were Willie “The Lion” Smith and he always introduced himself as, “Hello this is Willie ‘The Lion’ Smith. Can I speak to your dad?”

ctx.x: He told me “Learned Father,” yes that’s right.

Yeah, that’s right. I had kind of forgotten that but when you brought up Jon then I realized — and he asked me if I would like to be in his group, a later version of his group, many, many years later but it was just — it was driving around the country in a car and it was him and me and Judith and I think one of the participants, the singers, was going to be Bruce Scott who did sing with my vocal group for a while. He was really good at all that Lambert, Hendricks & Ross stuff. But yeah, I just — I never really…
